summary: AstroCare is an offline-first astronaut health-monitoring platform combining real NASA OSDR biospecimen data, a hybrid physiological simulation engine, and a 3D Digital Twin. Its onboard Astro AI assistant acts as a doctor, fitness coach, nutritionist, and sleep/mood guide to deliver plain-language decision support during deep-space communication delays.
